sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: Go：channel 容量與背壓
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付ownership圖、預期通過／拒絕程式；payload估算不等於Rust Vec實際總大小。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver ownership diagrams and pass/reject examples; payload estimates are not total Vec memory sizes. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 列send、receive、close、blocked四事件，將占用與已完成總件數分開。
related.differenceEn: Trace send, receive, close and blocked events, separating occupancy from cumulative completed items.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
借用規則限制同時存在的可變及共享存取；生命週期表達參照有效範圍，不是執行期倒數計時。
本課數值核對：4*4 = 16 B；另一項核對：2*4*4 = 32 B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

channel傳遞與同步關聯，buffer容量限制未消費項目；關閉是發送方生命周期事件，不是任意一個consumer的清理捷徑。
本課數值核對：5-2 = 3 items；另一項核對：3+1 = 4 items。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Borrowing constrains simultaneous mutable and shared accesses; lifetimes express reference validity, not runtime countdowns.
Numeric audit: 4*4 = 16 B; second audit: 2*4*4 = 32 B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Channels couple communication and synchronization; capacity bounds unconsumed values. Closing belongs to sender lifecycle, not arbitrary consumer cleanup.
Numeric audit: 5-2 = 3 items; second audit: 3+1 = 4 items. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: WebAssembly LEB128：變長整數與位元邊界
related.titleEn: WebAssembly LEB128: variable-length integers and bit boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付ownership圖、預期通過／拒絕程式；payload估算不等於Rust Vec實際總大小。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver ownership diagrams and pass/reject examples; payload estimates are not total Vec memory sizes. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 逐byte移除high bit，左移7k再OR；反向重新編碼核對byte序列。
related.differenceEn: Remove each high bit, shift payload by7k and OR, then re-encode to check the byte sequence.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
借用規則限制同時存在的可變及共享存取；生命週期表達參照有效範圍，不是執行期倒數計時。
本課數值核對：4*4 = 16 B；另一項核對：2*4*4 = 32 B。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

LEB128每byte提供七個payload bits與continuation bit；signed與unsigned解碼不能混用，還需限制位元寬度。
本課數值核對：101+14*128+38*16384 = 624485 value；另一項核對：ceil(32/7) = 5 max_bytes。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Borrowing constrains simultaneous mutable and shared accesses; lifetimes express reference validity, not runtime countdowns.
Numeric audit: 4*4 = 16 B; second audit: 2*4*4 = 32 B. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

LEB128 provides seven payload bits plus a continuation bit per byte; signed and unsigned forms differ and require width limits.
Numeric audit: 101+14*128+38*16384 = 624485 value; second audit: ceil(32/7) = 5 max_bytes. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
